subject: POC windowing and readiness — Greenfield Systems kickoff coordination
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@greenfield.io>, Platform SRE <platform-sre@greenfield.io>, Greenfield Procurement <procurement@greenfield.io>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: proposed windows, success criteria, and owners

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Were excited to run a short 3-week POC with Greenfield to validate latency, cost-inference economics, and integration with your streaming ingestion pipeline. To get the kickoff on calendar I wanted to propose a couple concrete windows and pull together owners so everyone knows whos owning what on day 0.

Proposed kickoff windows (90-120 min):
- Tue Mar 16, 10:00-11:30 ET (preferred)
- Thu Mar 18, 14:00-15:30 ET (backup)

Suggested attendees and owners:
- Karthik Iyer (AE) — demo + commercial context
- Camila Reyes (SE) — architecture walkthrough + hands-on run
- Sofia Ivanova (Solutions Lead) — onboarding, success criteria, metrics
- Platform SRE (Greenfield) — infra constraints & networking
- Procurement Rep (Greenfield) — billing/contract items

Kickoff agenda (30/45/30):
- 15m: intros, success criteria alignment (SLA targets, throughput targets)
- 30m: SE demo (integration, auth, sample traffic)
- 30/45m: runbook & handoff (test plan, telemetry, next steps)

Success criteria (what we want to validate during POC):
- End-to-end latency under 250ms p95 for 1k token requests in your dev env
- Cost per 1k tokens within the threshold you shared (estimate attached)
- Integration with existing auth flow (OIDC) and KV caching verified

Attachments: GF_POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (runbook/assignments), short calendar stub above.

Can you confirm which window works for your core attendees (Platform SRE + procurement)? If those two slots dont work, send a couple alternatives and well coordinate internally.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@greenfield.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Platform SRE <platform-sre@greenfield.io>, Greenfield Procurement <procurement@greenfield.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: proposed windows, success criteria, and owners

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few constraints from our side:
- Platform SRE (Tom Barnes) is deep in a migration the week of Mar 15 and cant do the 16th slot. Hes available on Mar 18 after 13:30 ET.
- Procurement needs a short list of terms to pre-clear (we dont need final contract yet but need a summary and a draft PO if possible).
- Security asked for a one-page architecture diagram and our SOC2 evidence requirement list prior to kickoff.

Ill loop Tom and procurement on scheduling. Proposed: Thu Mar 18, 14:00-15:30 ET looks possible if you can share the two quick items (arch diagram + terms summary) by EOD Monday.

Alice Wu
Head of Product Engineering | Greenfield Systems
alice.wu@greenfield.io

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: proposed windows, success criteria, and owners

Karthik / Camila / Priyom —

Per Alice: Mar 18 looks like the working window. Action items we need to close before Monday EOD so Alice can circulate internally:
- Camila: attach a concise one-page architecture diagram (highlighting auth flow, VPC peering expectations, and sample traffic path).
- Priyom: prepare a terms-summary + draft PO template they can use (high level, 90-day POC billing, cancellation, data handling).
- Karthik: confirm final attendee list and publish a calendar invite (Google event link preferred).
- Sofia: Ill own success criteria doc and the post-kickoff 3-week run plan (owners, signals, rollback criteria).

Proposed internal owners mapping for the kickoff itself:
- Success criteria owner: Sofia Ivanova
- Technical lead (demo & integration): Camila Reyes
- Commercial & procurement contact: Priyom Das
- AE coordination / agenda: Karthik Iyer

If anyone sees conflicts with Mar 18, flag them now — otherwise we lock and share the invite.

Thanks —
Sofia
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@greenfield.io>, Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@greenfield.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: proposed windows, success criteria, and owners

Alice / Tom —

Attaching a short architecture diagram and a quick network checklist to help your infra team validate connectivity ahead of the kickoff. See attached: network-checklist.xlsx and a one-page PNG of the flow (in Drive link below).

Pre-kickoff technical prerequisites (quick summary):
- Test service account with OIDC credentials for our test traffic (scoped to staging namespace)
- Allow outbound TLS to api.redwood.com (443) from two test instances
- If youre using egress proxies, allow long-lived websocket streaming to api.redwood.com

If Tom can confirm network preflight by Wed EOD PST well proceed with the Mar 18 slot. Ill also include a 15m slot at the end of kickoff for a short smoke test with your SRE.

Camila Reyes
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: network-checklist.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1POC-Runbook

From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@greenfield.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@greenfield.io>, Greenfield Procurement <procurement@greenfield.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 20:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC windowing and readiness — Greenfield Systems kickoff coordination

Thanks everyone — Mar 18 14:00-15:30 ET is confirmed. Tom and procurement are on the invite. A couple quick notes before kickoff:
- Procurement asked that Priyoms terms-summary include billing contacts and an invoice to our PO format (theyll review the draft PO you send).
- Security will bring a short checklist to the kickoff; they asked for the architecture PNG and SOC2 summary in the event packet (Camila / Sofia, can we include those in the calendar event?).
- Success criteria look good; well expect a short sign-off form at the end of week 3 to capture acceptance.

Looking forward to it.

Alice
